newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK services exports to grow 8.0 pct in 1997 -Tsang.
newsitem.headline: HK services exports to grow 8.0 pct in 1997 -Tsang.

text.p: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Thursday the growth rate of export of services fell to six percent in 1996 from 11 percent in 1995, and export of services would rise by eight percent in 1997.
"Total export of goods will grow by 8.5 percent (in 1997) with domestic exports static but re-exports rising by 10 percent," Tsang said.
Domestic exports fell by eight percent in 1996 compared to growth of two percent in 1995. Re-exports grew by eight percent in 1996 compared with 14 percent in 1995, he said.
